# artifactkeeper_telemetry_settings (Resource)

Global telemetry and crash-reporting settings, a singleton (one instance regardless of how many times declared; delete is a no-op and doesn't reset the backend). Every field is optional; an unset field keeps the currently stored value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artifactkeeper_telemetry_settings" "this" {
  enabled            = true
  review_before_send = true
  scrub_level        = "standard"
  include_logs       = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether telemetry and crash reporting are enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `include_logs` (Boolean) Whether application logs are attached to crash reports. Defaults to `false`.
- `review_before_send` (Boolean) Whether crash reports are held for manual review before submission upstream. Defaults to `true`.
- `scrub_level` (String) PII scrubbing level applied to crash reports: `minimal` (emails and IPs only), `standard` (also usernames, repo and artifact names, file paths and JWTs) or `aggressive` (all potentially identifying information). Defaults to `standard`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for the telemetry settings singleton (always `telemetry`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the id is always "telemetry".
terraform import artifactkeeper_telemetry_settings.this telemetry
```
